name: honeycomb-lanes
description: Report each Claude Code session to a HoneyComb cockpit as an agent lane (start / phase / heartbeat / stop). Sends phase, time and a short label only; never prompts, tool input or transcript content.

cockpit_url.title: Cockpit URL
cockpit_url.description: Where your HoneyComb cockpit listens, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8800/. Leave empty to use the COCKPIT_URL environment variable or the config file instead.

cockpit_token.title: Device token (optional)
cockpit_token.description: A HoneyComb device token. Leave empty on a single-user cockpit that accepts token-less reports.
